digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, completion verification, operator-attestation semantics
propositions: Operator-attested describes evidence location, not the identity of the actor who records it; agents may freely record truthful concrete evidence they observed

Plan material fingerprint is invalidated when the [operator-attested] tag is added to a criterion in the description after plan certification, causing completion verification to fail with stale-material before evidence evaluation occurs
The [operator-attested] tag must be added to criterion text before plan review; concrete evidence may then be recorded in ticket comments without further material impact
Completion-verifier remediation guidance instructs users to tag and comment after delivery, which conflicts with the material-pinning design that requires tagging before plan certification
Existing safeguards for exact-tag matching, concrete-specificity requirement, and command-versus-attestation distinction remain unchanged and enforced
